summary: Iteration 36: tested the App Store readiness fixes at 390x844, with backend checks through the public URL. Backend: 10/10 pytest passed. Auth guards return 401/403 on block, blocked and report. POST /chat/block adds and removes the contact, and blocking twice does not duplicate it. GET /chat/blocked and the blocked flag in GET /chat/messages/{id} match the block state. POST /chat/messages returns 403 while the contact is blocked and 200 after unblock. POST /chat/report saves a chat_reports doc (confirmed in the DB) and blocks the contact; with block=false it does not block. A conversation that isn't yours gives 404. An empty reason or one over 200 characters gives 422. The admin Resend email returned 200. Frontend: register shows reg-legal, and its Terms and Privacy links open phoenix-atlas.com/terms and /privacy (both return 200). Settings has the 'Help & legal' section (open-support, open-privacy and open-terms, each 342x56), the privacy and terms rows open the right URLs, and the Subscription section is visible on web. In chat/[id], chat-safety opens chat-safety-sheet with Report and Block. The report-reason screen lists 4 reasons. Reporting shows the confirmation, blocks the contact and replaces the composer with chat-blocked-banner, and this survives a reload. Unblocking via Manage or chat-block-toggle brings the composer back, blocking from the toggle works, tapping the backdrop closes the sheet, and messages send again after unblock. On /vault-pro (smoketest is already Pro) vaultpro-price shows £9.99/month and vaultpro-manage-billing shows; vaultpro-subscribe is correctly hidden for a Pro user and could not be checked with this account. /remit loads normally. No page errors. AppErrorBoundary is exported from app/_layout.tsx (code review only; a crash was not triggered). Cleanup: the smoketest user has no blocked contacts, and test reports and TEST_ messages were deleted.

minor.issue: contact_id is not checked: any string, including another user's contact id, is added to blocked_contacts. Check that the contact belongs to the user (db.contacts {id, user_id}) and return 404 if not.
Block is not enforced here. You can still send crypto to a blocked contact in the chat, though the UI hides the composer. Decide whether this is intended; otherwise return 403 like /chat/messages.
Admin emails are sent one after another before the response returns, which adds latency (about 400ms with 2 admins). Consider asyncio.create_task or a background task.

issues: The chat-safety ellipsis is 20x23px (hitSlop 8, so about 36px on native, and hitSlop does not apply on web). chat-call is 22x24px with no hitSlop. Both are below the 44pt minimum; give them a minWidth/minHeight 44 wrapper.
In report-reason mode there is no Back option to return to the Safety menu, only Close.
The inline Terms and Privacy policy links are 12px text with no testIDs and small tap targets. Add testIDs reg-terms-link and reg-privacy-link.

Possible Apple 3.1.1/3.1.3 risk: the PreviewBanner text 'billed LIVE via Stripe' and the 'Securely billed by Stripe' tinyNote are shown on every platform, and for existing Pro users on iOS, vaultpro-manage-billing opens the Stripe portal (an external payment mechanism). Consider gating these behind PRO_PURCHASE_ENABLED as well.

action_items: (Optional, Apple 3.1.1 hardening) In vault-pro.tsx, hide the Stripe wording in the PreviewBanner and tinyNote, and the Manage billing button (Stripe portal), when Platform.OS==='ios'.
Make the chat header icons (chat-safety, chat-call) at least 44x44.
(Optional) Add a Back option in ChatSafetySheet report mode, and testIDs on the register Terms and Privacy links.
critical_code_review_comments: The iOS gating via PRO_PURCHASE_ENABLED is applied consistently in settings (Subscription row and multisig upsell), remit (upgrade CTA and paywall copy), cosigners (upsell) and vault-pro (price and subscribe).
Blocking is enforced only on the user's own outbound path (/chat/messages). Push notifications from blocked contacts are not filtered, which is acceptable for this seeded-contact model.
A report on a group conversation stores contact_id=None and does not block anyone; the UI hides Block for groups, which is consistent.
